Hi Alex / Sam,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. As promised, attaching a concise SLO checklist so we can align on performance targets needed for your integration. A few things we captured during the call:

- Target p95 latency: <= 200 ms for short text generation routes (50–256 tokens)
- Required throughput: ~200 requests/sec for peak flows (batching expected)
- Concurrency: support ~50 concurrent streams (websocket/HTTP streaming for partial responses)
- Streaming: yes — partial tokens must be delivered within 100ms of generation for better UX
- Failure tolerance: graceful fallback to smaller model or queued responses when capacity constrained

Action items we proposed on the call:
1) Your team to confirm the above targets and any additional routes (e.g., embeddings, reranker).
2) Redwood to run a short benchmark plan (2–3 day run) and share latency/throughput/cost estimates.
3) Decide on a POC mode: Hosted with reserved concurrency vs Dedicated pool for guaranteed throughput.

I attached the SLO checklist for you to review (redwood-slo-checklist.xlsx). Please reply with any changes to the targets or if you want us to include additional endpoints/test prompts. If you agree, we’ll schedule the benchmark next week and loop in engineering.

Marissa / Rishi,

Quick plan and notes below (high level):

1) Benchmark plan (attached):
- 48–72 hour run using their representative prompt set (we’ll ingest ~10k sample prompts across routes).
- Traffic mix: 70% short chat (50–256 tokens), 20% mid (256–500), 10% long-form (500–1k).
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, time-to-first-byte (TTFB) for streaming, tokens/sec, CPU/GPU util, and cost per 1M tokens.
- Deliverable: report + CSV of raw samples and aggregated charts.

2) Hosted vs Dedicated for streaming:
- Hosted supports streaming with low tail latency in most regions, but strict TTFB <=100ms at p95 during peak concurrency (50 streams) is best achieved on Dedicated with pinned GPU capacity and tuned batching.
- Recommendation: run the benchmark on Hosted first (faster to start), measure TTFB at concurrency targets. If p95 TTFB > 100ms, propose a short Dedicated trial (1–2 week reserved pool) for final validation.

3) Ballpark cost delta:
- Hosted reserved concurrency (soft reservation + burst): estimated incremental cost ~+$7k–$12k/mo for the traffic profile.
- Dedicated small pool (1–2 pinned GPUs, depending on model/quantization): estimated starting ~+$18k–$35k/mo (large variance based on model choice).

Attachments: benchmark-plan.md (high-level test plan), cost-estimate-approx.csv

I’ll prepare the Hosted benchmark run config (load profile + sample prompts) and can kick it off once Alex/Sam confirm the prompt set and test window.

—Aditya
